title: Cambridge IELTS 18 Test 3 Writing Task 2
directions:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Write about the following topic:
prompt:
In many countries around the world, rural people are moving to cities, so the population in the countryside is decreasing.

Do you think this is a positive or a negative development?
scenario: In many countries around the world, rural people are moving to cities, so the population in the countryside is decreasing.
requirements: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
